sections.text:
Once upon a time, Juha owned a spacious and beautiful house that he inherited from his ancestors, but he went through severe financial hardship and was forced to put the house up for sale.

A wealthy man, a stranger to the city, came to buy the house. He liked it very much, and they agreed on the final price, which was rather low due to Juha's desperate need for money.

Before they signed the sales contract, Juha said to the buyer: “I will sell you the entire house and everything in it, except for one nail fixed to the wall in the front of the guest room. This nail is dear to me and I will not sell it.”

The buyer was surprised and said to himself: “What harm will a small nail in a large wall do? I will agree to complete the winning sale.”

The buyer agreed and wrote in the contract: “The house is sold, except for Juha’s nail.”

The buyer moved into the house and lived there comfortably, but after a week, a loud knock was heard at the door, and the man opened it to find Juha in front of him.

The buyer said: “Hello, Juha, what do you want?”

Juha answered coldly: “I came to check on my nail!”

Juha entered and sat in the guest room looking at the nail for long hours until Jupiter got bored and angry.

The following week, Juha came carrying his turban and old cloak, entered and hung them on the nail, then left.

Days passed, and one day when Jupiter was hosting a dinner for his important guests, Juha suddenly entered carrying a cage containing a dead chicken and it smelled very bad!
Juha hung the dead chicken on the nail and said to the guests: “Excuse me, gentlemen, this is my nail and I am free to hang anything on it!”

A stench spread through the room, and the guests ran away cursing Jupiter for his poor hospitality.

Jupiter went crazy and shouted at Juha: “What are you doing, Juha?! You have ruined my life with this nail!”

Juha replied calmly: “Didn’t we agree in the contract that the nail is mine? The law protects me, and I have the right to visit my nail and hang on it whatever I want!”

The buyer could not bear this constant torture and embarrassment in front of people, so he decided to give up the house completely!
The buyer said desperately: “Take the house, everything in it, and your nail with it, and I will leave in peace!”

Thus, Juha regained his home with a very clever and cunning plan, and Juha's nail became an example for anyone who uses a weak excuse to interfere in the affairs of others and impose his control over them.
